fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Post the address number on both the main residence and the detached structure so responders can identify each building quickly on arrival.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles to allow fire and emergency apparatus to reach both structures.
• Trim trees and shrubs along the access drive so emergency vehicles can pass without obstruction.
• Mark the detached structure clearly so responders arriving at night can locate it without searching the property.
• Clear a turnaround area at or near the end of the access drive large enough for an emergency vehicle to reverse direction without backing the full length of the drive.
• Keep the walkway between the main residence and detached structure free of stored items so responders can move quickly between buildings.
• Trim vegetation along the walkway connecting the two structures to maintain clear movement on foot.
• Cut back dense vegetation around the perimeter of both structures so responders can move around each building and identify access points.
• Keep any gates on the property unlocked or secured with a lock box accessible to emergency responders.
• Thin dense plantings near the detached structure so it remains visible from the access drive.
• Notify your local fire department of the solar panel system location and main disconnect location so crews are aware before entering the property.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin trees within the clusters closest to the structure to create open gaps between individual trees.
• Trim lower branches on large trees near the structure to raise the canopy off the ground.
• Remove shrubs and low-growing plants that are directly touching or within a few feet of the structure walls.
• Separate tree clusters from one another where they connect or nearly connect near the structure.
• Keep scattered trees near the structure trimmed of dead branches and low limbs.
• Clear dead leaves, needles, and plant debris that have collected against the structure foundation and walls.
• Keep all access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation so vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
• Maintain open terrain areas near the structure free of debris piles, cut brush, or accumulated dry plant material.
• Keep secondary access routes passable by trimming vegetation that is narrowing the travel path.
